exposure: Delta variant COVID-19 infection during pregnancy
outcome: maternal condition worsening due to COVID-19
cohort: The study included 173 mother-baby dyads of pregnant women diagnosed with COVID-19 infections in one large public, non-profit hospital system between January 2020 and November 2021.
finding: Pregnant women with COVID-19 during the Delta variant period experienced higher rates of preterm deliveries and their liveborn babies had longer lengths of hospital stay compared to the pre-Delta period.
mod_finding: The Delta variant period was associated with a higher rate of cesarean sections, particularly due to worsening maternal condition and non-reassuring fetal heart tones.
